FEATURED TRAILERS
London - Islington (Angel Central)
Located in the Angel Central Shopping Centre, Vue Islington has 10 screens - including an EPIC screen - seating 700 people in Ultra Lux and Lux seats.
Watch the newest releases at the town’s state-of-the-art cinema, and enjoy 2D and 3D films. Go bigger, Go EPIC - Take things to the next level with breathtaking colour, next level 3D sound, on our biggest screen, now available in Vue Islington. Laser projection is brighter, sharper, better. And it’s at every screen. You can experience the Lux , a reclining leather seat with a handy foldaway table. Why not upgrade to the Ultra Lux , with wider seats and extra room for serious lounging, personal table with back and legs that recline independently, for a screen experience like no other. Catch the newest blockbuster movies and kids’ films , or watch the best concerts, sport, dance, opera, and theatre performances with our Big Screen Events . Check out the latest trailers , browse cinema listings and times, and book tickets online for Vue Islington. Take advantage of special screenings and offers at Vue Islington, including Mighty Mornings or Big Shorts for kids and 2-for-1 tickets with Meerkat Movies.

Accessibility
Vue is dedicated to giving each and every one of our guests an exceptional big screen experience.
Below, you'll find accessibility information for Vue London - Islington (Angel Central), including details on accessible and autism-friendly screenings. We welcome assistance dogs into all our venues.
If you'd like any more information, give our customer services team a call on 0345 308 4620 *. You can also ask a member of our staff during your visit.
